heading_path: 3A.7  AFS request—grant of extension of time
text: (1) The Registrar may grant the application only if the Registrar is satisfied that the grounds set out in the application justify the extension. (2) The Registrar must decide the length of the extended period having regard to what is reasonable in the circumstances. (3) The Registrar must not grant more than one extension for an AFS request.
